problem: Artist page tabs (Feed/Music/Posts/Photos/Videos) use client-only activeTab state and are not URL-addressable. All data loads upfront regardless of active view, preventing lazy loading and per-view caching. URLs like /artist/[slug] cannot deep-link to specific views and are not shareable/bookmarkable per tab.
requirements: Create URL-addressable routes at /artist/[slug]/[view] where view ∈ {feed, music, posts, photos, videos}
URLs for specific views are bookmarkable and survive page reload
Navigation between views uses client-side routing (goto/navigation) without full page reload
Data loads lazily server-side: only data for the initially-loaded view is fetched, not all three (tracks/albums/content)
Views that have been loaded stay cached client-side; re-navigating to an already-loaded view does not trigger re-fetch
Navigation between views does not call invalidateAll() and does not re-run the page load function
Tabs component supports URL-driven navigation with href-based click handlers
Default view is feed when no [view] parameter is provided (/artist/[slug] redirects to /artist/[slug]/feed)
outOfScope: Deep linking to nested content within views (specific posts, tracks, or galleries)
Implementing a Shop view (already marked as coming soon)
Changes to subscription/entitlement logic or access control
Refactoring individual content component files (ArtistFeed, ArtistTracks, ArtistPosts, etc.)
Changes to the chat widget or sidebar layout
